decisions.why: framework-coverage batch 09/11/2026, Intravenous Cannula and Associated Products. The division's own site filing names it "I.V. Cannula" and its 6 products (Modcann W+, Ecowin, Ecocann W, Ecocann S, Ecocann N, Ecocann) are, per the supplier's own product page (praxis-medical.co.uk/product/ecocann/), described as "I.V Cannula with wings & injection port. Sizes 14G to 26G" -- a winged, ported, gauge-sized cannula is the standard peripheral venous cannula form factor, matching vascular:pivc (Peripheral IV cannula). No central/midline language (French size, catheter length in cm) appears anywhere in the division.
